title: Conjugate acid–base pairs
caption: HCl donates a proton to water. HCl and Cl⁻ are a conjugate pair, differing by one H⁺; H₂O and H₃O⁺ are the other. Water acts as a Brønsted–Lowry base here.
alt: HCl + H₂O → Cl⁻ + H₃O⁺ drawn as structures, with the conjugate pairs labelled.
description: HCl, the acid, gives up H⁺ and becomes Cl⁻, its conjugate base.
H₂O, the base, gains H⁺ and becomes H₃O⁺, its conjugate acid.
